WITH organic_high_sensitivity AS (
    SELECT sc.ART_link
    FROM "SensitivityData" sc
    WHERE sc."ENVsense" = 'High'
),
organic_artifacts AS (
    SELECT ac.ARTregID
    FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
    WHERE ac."MatKind" IN ('Wood', 'Textile', 'Paper')
),
high_value_by_score AS (
    SELECT ar."ART_link", ar."HIST_sign", 
           (ar."rating_profile" ->> 'cultural_score')::int as cultural_score
    FROM "ArtifactRatings" ar
    WHERE ar."HIST_sign" >= (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "HIST_sign") FROM "ArtifactRatings")
      AND (ar."rating_profile" ->> 'cultural_score')::int >= (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (ar2."rating_profile" ->> 'cultural_score')::int) FROM "ArtifactRatings" ar2)
),
precious_organic AS (
    SELECT oa.ARTregID
    FROM organic_artifacts oa
    JOIN organic_high_sensitivity ohs ON oa.ARTregID = ohs.ART_link
    UNION
    SELECT hv."ART_link"
    FROM high_value_by_score hv
    JOIN organic_artifacts oa ON hv."ART_link" = oa.ARTregID
)
SELECT pa.ARTregID, ac.art_title, ac."MatKind", ac.DYNASTY, ac.ageYears,
       sd."ENVsense", sd.env_handling_sensitivity
FROM precious_organic pa
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON pa.ARTregID = ac.ARTregID
JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON pa.ARTregID = sd.ART_link;
